clue.text: Masterstroke putting minister back in front

indicators.note: in signals that the turned title sits inside the masterstroke word

parts.note: a coup is a brilliant stroke or masterly move

indicators.note: back tells us to read the minister's abbreviation the other way round

parts.note: Rev is the abbreviated title of a clergyman, a minister of religion

explanation.surface: A clever political move puts a minister back at the front of affairs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'front' looks as if it goes with 'in' ('in front'), but it is the definition. 'back' makes VER and 'in' is the container indicator.
explanation.definitionFit: A front is a facade hiding the truth, just as a whitewash conceals what really happened.

clue.text: Appropriate place to hold a tie?

definitions.meaning: to appropriate is to seize, as a policeman nabs a suspect
the neckband of a shirt, round which a necktie is knotted

explanation.definitionFit: To grab hold of is to seize, and the neckband of a shirt is where a necktie sits.

clue.text: Sort of evil edict that is written out in full

definitions.text: that is written out in full

indicators.note: to sort is to arrange, so these letters are sorted into a new order

explanation.surface: A wicked decree that has been spelled out completely.
explanation.walkthrough: The abbreviation 'viz.' means 'that is'; written out in full, it is the Latin word meaning 'namely'.
explanation.definitionFit: The Latin word meaning namely, usually shortened to viz.

clue.text: Wine, and with it fruit

parts.note: rosé is pink wine
hip means fashionable, or with it

explanation.surface: Wine, along with something to eat.
explanation.definitionFit: The red seed pod of the wild rose is a fruit.

clue.text: Bodyguard for Commonwealth head of state

definitions.meaning: someone who keeps another person safe
Oliver Cromwell's title as head of the English Commonwealth of the 1650s was Lord ______

explanation.definitionFit: A guardian keeps someone safe, and Cromwell ruled the 1650s Commonwealth with that title.

clue.text: Given a catch that's held

definitions.meaning: fitted with a fastening such as a buckle or hook
gripped tightly in the hands or arms

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses come from the same verb: to fasten with a hook, or to grip someone tightly.

clue.text: Keen fellow, possessing energy

indicators.note: possessing means holding, so the energy symbol goes inside the fellow word

parts.note: a chap is a fellow
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: An enthusiastic man full of vigour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Keen' looks like 'eager', but here it means low in price, as in 'keen prices'.
explanation.definitionFit: Keen prices are low prices, so keen can mean inexpensive.

clue.text: Order a record player, having unlimited budget

parts.note: a disc jockey (DJ) plays records

indicators.note: unlimited means without its limits, so the first and last letters of budget go

explanation.surface: Commission a disc jockey with no limit on what you spend.
explanation.walkthrough: 'record player' looks like the machine but is the person, the DJ.
explanation.definitionFit: To adjudge is to decree or rule formally, as a judge does when giving an order.

clue.text: Bird that can be spotted in Europe, we expect

indicators.note: can be spotted in means the bird can be seen inside these words

explanation.surface: We expect this bird to be sighted in Europe.
explanation.walkthrough: The birdwatching surface hides the bird in 'EuroPE WE Expect'. It is in fact an American flycatcher.
explanation.definitionFit: A small American flycatcher.

clue.text: Moving tardily, with nothing gained?

indicators.note: moving means shifting position, so these letters are shifted about

parts.note: O looks like zero, or nothing

explanation.surface: Going slowly gets you nowhere.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Moving' rearranges TARDILY with O added ('with nothing gained'). The whole clue also defines the answer: a slow mover gains nothing.
explanation.definitionFit: Slow and inclined to delay, which is how a dawdler goes.

clue.text: Something attractive model lets one do

indicators.note: to model is to shape or fashion, so these letters are moulded into a new order

explanation.surface: A fashion model allows someone to do something alluring.
explanation.walkthrough: 'model' looks like a noun for a person, but here it is the verb 'shape', telling you to rearrange LETS ONE DO.
explanation.definitionFit: A naturally magnetic stone attracts iron, which makes it literally attractive.

clue.text: Contract set in which partners go for one diamond, say

indicators.note: in which tells us the partners are placed inside the shortened word
contract means shorten, so a letter is dropped from the word for set

parts.note: to jell is to set, as a jelly does
East and West are partners at the bridge table

explanation.surface: At the bridge table a contract is set in which the partners bid one diamond.
explanation.walkthrough: The bridge surface (contract, partners, diamonds) is misdirection. 'Contract' trims a letter to give JEL, and 'in which' places the bridge partners East and West inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A single diamond is an example of a gem, which the 'say' marks as one instance.

clue.text: A passage about God

indicators.note: about here means turned round, so the word for passage is read backwards

parts.note: a hall is a passage or corridor inside a building

explanation.surface: A biblical passage concerning God.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' looks as if it means 'concerning', but it is the reversal indicator, giving LLAH.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the Arabic name of the supreme deity in Islam.

clue.text: Meet in a resort

definitions.meaning: an old adjective meaning fitting or proper
a means turned to in a difficulty, as in 'last resort'

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses mean something useful: a suitable thing to do, or a handy device to fall back on.

clue.text: Type of leading character I could be

definitions.text: Type of leading character I could be

parts.words: Type of leading character I could be
parts.note: type here means printing type, and the first-person pronoun is always printed as an upper-case letter, the kind that starts a sentence

explanation.definitionFit: Upper-case print, used for the first letter of a sentence and always for the pronoun I.

clue.text: Carry on with article very late

parts.note: to last is to carry on or continue
an article is an object, a thing

explanation.surface: Carry on with an item very late in the day.
explanation.walkthrough: 'article' looks like 'a' or 'the', but here it means an object.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means at the very end of the day, just before bed.

clue.text: Treasury concocted a ruse to divide in such a fashion

indicators.note: to divide means to split, so the mixed letters go into the middle of the other word

parts.note: thus means in this way

indicators.note: concocted means made up or cooked up, so the letters are mixed

explanation.surface: The Treasury cooked up a trick to split things like this.
explanation.walkthrough: 'concocted' gives ESAUR, and 'to divide' tells you it splits the word for 'in such a fashion'. 'Treasury' sounds like government, but it is the book's original title (Roget's Thesaurus).
explanation.definitionFit: Roget called his book of words grouped by meaning a treasury of words.

clue.text: Creation — a French one with measured lines

parts.note: un is the French for a
I is the Roman numeral for one
verse is writing in metred lines

explanation.surface: Creation as a French poem in metre.
explanation.definitionFit: All of creation, everything that exists, is the cosmos.

clue.text: Book on constitution — a protected tract

indicators.note: in an across clue, on means placed after, so the book word follows

parts.note: a person's constitution is their nature or make-up
to book a seat is to reserve it

explanation.surface: A book about the constitution covers protected land.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Book' looks like a noun but is the verb 'reserve'. 'on' puts it after NATURE.
explanation.definitionFit: This is an area of land set aside and protected for wildlife and plants.

clue.text: Traveller allowed back on plane that's full

parts.note: a rep is a commercial traveller, a salesman on the road
to let is to allow

indicators.note: back on means the hindmost letter on the following word is used

explanation.surface: A salesman is allowed back on a fully booked flight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back on plane' looks like re-boarding, but it gives only the last letter of 'plane', E.
explanation.definitionFit: Replete means filled up, especially with food.

clue.text: To be seen changing leader is absurd

indicators.note: changing leader means the first letter is swapped for another

parts.note: visible means able to be seen

explanation.surface: Being seen to change leaders is ridiculous.
explanation.walkthrough: 'changing leader' swaps the V of VISIBLE for R. The new letter has to come from the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Something laughable is ridiculous or absurd.

clue.text: Came across note that's upset plan

parts.note: met means came across or encountered

indicators.note: upset in a down clue means turned upside down, so the note is read backwards

parts.note: doh is the first note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A note was found that ruined the scheme.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' turns DOH upside down in the down entry, making HOD.
explanation.definitionFit: A system or way of proceeding is a plan.

clue.text: Consider the head's position

parts.note: to view a matter is to consider it
the head of a spear or pin is its point

explanation.surface: Think about where the headmaster stands.
explanation.definitionFit: A position is a stance or opinion on a question.

clue.text: Like spots, appear suddenly and clear up over time

indicators.note: up in a down entry means the word is written bottom to top

parts.note: pure means clear, untainted

explanation.surface: Spots appear suddenly, then clear up over time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'clear up' sounds like the spots fading, but 'up' turns PURE into ERUP.
explanation.definitionFit: Spots on the skin are said to break out, just as a volcano bursts out.

clue.text: Still upset? Not very

annotationWithheld.why: Still upset? Not very (5) for INERT: 'Still' defines it, but no parse of 'upset? Not very' gives the letters, and no source gives the setter's wordplay.

clue.text: Instant drink

explanation.definitionFit: 'In a shake' means in a moment, and a milkshake is a drink.

clue.text: Regular performance that's lacking in a way

indicators.note: lacking means going without, so the following little word is taken out

parts.note: a routine is a regular act or set performance
taken as written

explanation.surface: A regular stage act that falls short in some respect.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lacking' takes IN out of ROUTINE. 'in a way' reads like a phrase, but 'in' is what is removed and 'a way' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A road or course taken from one place to another is a way.

clue.text: City spread out under big hill originally

indicators.note: spread out means scattered and rearranged, signalling an anagram of what follows
originally means at the start, so only the opening letter of hill is used

explanation.surface: A town sprawls below a large hill.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spread out' rearranges UNDER, BIG and H. 'originally' supplies the H, the first letter of 'hill'.
explanation.definitionFit: Scotland's capital, which really does lie beneath a big hill, Arthur's Seat.

clue.text: Ask leaderless soldiers to parley

indicators.note: leaderless means without its first letter

parts.note: the men are the ordinary soldiers of an army
to treat with an enemy is to negotiate or parley

explanation.surface: Ask soldiers whose commander has gone to negotiate with the enemy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leaderless' cuts the first letter from MEN, leaving EN.
explanation.definitionFit: To beg or earnestly request is to ask.

clue.text: Fancied some company, say

indicators.note: say tells us the word is spoken, so we want a word that sounds like it

parts.note: one of the company at a party is a guest

explanation.surface: Someone fancied a bit of company.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fancied' suggests attraction, but here it means supposed.
explanation.definitionFit: To fancy something is to suppose or imagine it, a guess.
